page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.cm4.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at 3.2 GHz. The configuration provides 24 vCPUs across 12 physical cores with 2 threads per core, supported by 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the instance in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. In CPU-intensive tasks, it achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1575.18 and a multi-core score of 24949.83, alongside a Geekbench multi-core score of 9204.0. Memory subsystem performance shows a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1392.19 GB/sec, which drops to 96.09 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. The CPU features AVX-512 vector extensions, which assist in tasks like bzip3 multi-threaded decompression, measured at 109.04 GB/sec, and Geekbench ray tracing at 18831.0. For database operations, the instance handles 23.45 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves a PassMark database score of 6820.79.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer stable, predictable compute capacity without the risk of resource contention. However, the complete absence of local NVMe storage represents a tradeoff, requiring external storage solutions that may introduce latency for I/O-heavy applications. The instance is suited for workloads such as static web serving, measured at 14.7 GB/sec throughput, software compilation with a Geekbench clang score of 20182.0, and moderate database operations. It can also handle small-scale language model inference, processing 135M parameter models at 82.11 text generation tokens per second, though it lacks the hardware acceleration required for larger models.
